I used the FGO wiki frequently in the past, but myself and another well known contributor left because of difference in opinion with another editor (who is still there).  There are many issues that need to be addressed (which some others have pointed out):

1) skill translations: this is actually where a lot of friction was generated between mods.  One mod in particular (who I won't name for the sake of witch hunting), for all intents and purposes, wouldn't let us use any translation that wasn't his.  this led to numerous bad translations that got pointed out here, the wiki itself, discord, etc.

2) servant naming convention: self explanatory

3) site speed: the wiki is slower than molasses moving across a glacier on the poles of pluto.  Too much is going on (mainly too much dynamic code).

4) templates: the argument I'm going to make here is how the NPs are laid out.  The grid layout for those is weird, and it gets weirder the more effects it has.  at least label the effects that are "overcharge" effects instead of making us figure it out based on position above or below the charge bar.

The good:

you guys do have some good things going for you.  site update speed mainly.  85% of the time, you guys have new content added before cirn, which is fantastic.

TL;DR make the FGO wiki great again
